patch.value: Allow non-colliding extension leaves beneath core command groups

GitHub source https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1249. A published pm-ops installation reportedly loses all ops leaves when core owns the group. Reproduce group versus leaf ownership through the published package; preserve same-leaf core ownership and remove contradictory self-suggestions. The older alias-collision work intentionally rejected nested grafts; this report requires a finer safe composition contract.
An extension-only ops leaf dispatches beside core ops; a true same-path collision remains refused with both owners; recovery never suggests the exact refused path.
Allow non-colliding extension leaves beneath core command groups
Lower agent recovery cost and preserve safe customizable SDK composition
